source_text: Woah! I didn’t expect to see her like this.

structure.raw_value: McShOp#>.Woah! I didn’t expect to see her like this.
structure.script_literal: "McShOp#>.Woah! I didn’t expect to see her like this."

translation: Łał! Nie spodziewałem się, że ją tak zobaczę.

source_text: Uhh... Sister Judy?

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Uhh... Sister Judy?
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Uhh... Sister Judy?"

translation: Eee... Siostro Judy?

source_text: 1Hero! Thank you for coming to see me.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp#.1Hero! Thank you for coming to see me.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp#.1Hero! Thank you for coming to see me."

translation: 1Hero! Dziękuję, że mnie odwiedziłeś.

source_text: Are you getting ready for bed? I hope I’m not too late.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Are you getting ready for bed? I hope I’m not too late.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Are you getting ready for bed? I hope I’m not too late."

translation: Szykujesz się do snu? Mam nadzieję, że nie jest za późno.

source_text: It’s fine. I’m just getting ready to water the plants.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.It’s fine. I’m just getting ready to water the plants.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.It’s fine. I’m just getting ready to water the plants."

translation: W porządku. Właśnie mam podlać rośliny.

source_text: It’s a bit unexpected. I didn’t think you'd be wearing… not wearing your nun gear.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.It’s a bit unexpected. I didn’t think you'd be wearing… not wearing your nun gear.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.It’s a bit unexpected. I didn’t think you'd be wearing… not wearing your nun gear."

translation: To trochę zaskakujące. Nie sądziłem, że będziesz… bez stroju zakonnego.

source_text: I don’t always wear my habit, you know.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.I don’t always wear my habit, you know.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.I don’t always wear my habit, you know."

translation: Wiesz, nie zawsze chodzę w habicie.

source_text: It’s nice to have company this late. I’m usually so bored in the evenings.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.It’s nice to have company this late. I’m usually so bored in the evenings.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.It’s nice to have company this late. I’m usually so bored in the evenings."

translation: Miło mieć towarzystwo o tak późnej porze. Wieczorami zwykle strasznie się nudzę.

source_text: No conversations with Father Solomon?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.No conversations with Father Solomon?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.No conversations with Father Solomon?"

translation: Nie rozmawiasz z ojcem Solomonem?

source_text: I see him all day. I typically just read a book, or study the Bible before bedtime prayer.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.I see him all day. I typically just read a book, or study the Bible before bedtime prayer.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.I see him all day. I typically just read a book, or study the Bible before bedtime prayer."

translation: Widzę go przez cały dzień. Zwykle czytam książkę albo studiuję Biblię przed wieczorną modlitwą.

source_text: If you don’t mind, I just need to finish up watering the plants.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.If you don’t mind, I just need to finish up watering the plants.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.If you don’t mind, I just need to finish up watering the plants."

translation: Jeśli nie masz nic przeciwko, muszę tylko dokończyć podlewanie roślin.

source_text: By all means. I’m not going anywhere.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.By all means. I’m not going anywhere.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.By all means. I’m not going anywhere."

translation: Jasne. Nigdzie się nie wybieram.

source_text: This one always gives me trouble.

structure.raw_value: JuWoOp#.This one always gives me trouble.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoOp#.This one always gives me trouble."

translation: Ta zawsze sprawia mi kłopoty.

source_text: Careful, Judy. Do you need some help?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Careful, Judy. Do you need some help?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Careful, Judy. Do you need some help?"

translation: Uważaj, Judy. Pomóc ci?

source_text: Would you, please?

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.Would you, please?
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.Would you, please?"

translation: Mógłbyś, proszę?

source_text: Look at you! You’re so tall.

structure.raw_value: JuHaOp#.Look at you! You’re so tall.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaOp#.Look at you! You’re so tall."

translation: Ale z ciebie wysoki chłopak!

source_text: I’m surprised you have a plant this high.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.I’m surprised you have a plant this high.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.I’m surprised you have a plant this high."

translation: Nie wiedziałem, że masz tak wysoko ustawioną roślinę.

source_text: Silly me. I should have just used my stool.

structure.raw_value: JuFrCl.Silly me. I should have just used my stool.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrCl.Silly me. I should have just used my stool."

translation: Ale ze mnie gapa. Powinnam była po prostu użyć stołka.

source_text: Or you could move the plant to a lower shelf.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Or you could move the plant to a lower shelf.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Or you could move the plant to a lower shelf."

translation: Albo mogłabyś przestawić roślinę na niższą półkę.

source_text: Of course! Smart and tall! A blessing for sure.

structure.raw_value: JuHaOp.Of course! Smart and tall! A blessing for sure.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaOp.Of course! Smart and tall! A blessing for sure."

translation: No jasne! Mądry i wysoki! Prawdziwe błogosławieństwo.

source_text: It’s a spider!

structure.raw_value: McShClNo1#>.It’s a spider!
structure.script_literal: "McShClNo1#>.It’s a spider!"

translation: Pająk!

source_text: Oh, my goodness! It’s so big!

structure.raw_value: JuWoClNo1.Oh, my goodness! It’s so big!
structure.script_literal: "JuWoClNo1.Oh, my goodness! It’s so big!"

translation: O mój Boże! Jaki wielki!

source_text: How did it get in here?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.How did it get in here?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.How did it get in here?"

translation: Jak on się tu dostał?

source_text: Has he been in my room this whole time?

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Has he been in my room this whole time?
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Has he been in my room this whole time?"

translation: Czy on przez cały czas był w moim pokoju?

source_text: Don’t worry. I can get it.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Don’t worry. I can get it.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Don’t worry. I can get it."

translation: Spokojnie. Zajmę się nim.

source_text: Don’t hurt him!

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Don’t hurt him!
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Don’t hurt him!"

translation: Nie rób mu krzywdy!

source_text: We should let him go outside. He might have family.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.We should let him go outside. He might have family.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.We should let him go outside. He might have family."

translation: Powinniśmy wypuścić go na zewnątrz. Może ma tam rodzinę.

source_text: I don’t know about that… But I guess I could capture it.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I don’t know about that… But I guess I could capture it.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I don’t know about that… But I guess I could capture it."

translation: Nie jestem pewien… Ale chyba mogę go złapać.

source_text: Be careful, 1Hero. We don’t know his temperament.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Be careful, 1Hero. We don’t know his temperament.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Be careful, 1Hero. We don’t know his temperament."

translation: Uważaj, 1Hero. Nie wiemy, jaki ma charakter.

source_text: Hey! I got it!

structure.raw_value: McHaOp#>.Hey! I got it!
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp#>.Hey! I got it!"

translation: Hej! Mam go!

source_text: Open the window. We can let it go.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Open the window. We can let it go.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Open the window. We can let it go."

translation: Otwórz okno. Wypuścimy go.

source_text: Come on. Jump out already.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp#>.Come on. Jump out already.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp#>.Come on. Jump out already."

translation: No dalej. Wyskakuj już.

source_text: What’s wrong? Why won't he leave?

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.What’s wrong? Why won't he leave?
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.What’s wrong? Why won't he leave?"

translation: Co się dzieje? Czemu nie chce wyjść?

source_text: You’re free, spider. Now get going.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.You’re free, spider. Now get going.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.You’re free, spider. Now get going."

translation: Jesteś wolny, pająku. A teraz zmykaj.

source_text: You can’t stay here… Your family is waiting for you outside.

structure.raw_value: JuWoOp.You can’t stay here… Your family is waiting for you outside.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoOp.You can’t stay here… Your family is waiting for you outside."

translation: Nie możesz tu zostać… Na zewnątrz czeka na ciebie rodzina.

source_text: He jumped out!

structure.raw_value: McHaOp#>.He jumped out!
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp#>.He jumped out!"

translation: Wyskoczył!

source_text: Oh, shit. He’s not going to jump back inside, is he?

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Oh, shit. He’s not going to jump back inside, is he?
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Oh, shit. He’s not going to jump back inside, is he?"

translation: O cholera. Chyba nie wskoczy z powrotem?

source_text: It looks like he’s waving at us…

structure.raw_value: JuBaOp.It looks like he’s waving at us…
structure.script_literal: "JuBaOp.It looks like he’s waving at us…"

translation: Wygląda, jakby do nas machał…

source_text: Maybe he’s saying thank you.

structure.raw_value: JuHaOp.Maybe he’s saying thank you.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaOp.Maybe he’s saying thank you."

translation: Może dziękuje.

source_text: Well, he better get going soon, or more bugs are going to come inside.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Well, he better get going soon, or more bugs are going to come inside.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Well, he better get going soon, or more bugs are going to come inside."

translation: Lepiej, żeby szybko sobie poszedł, bo zaraz wejdą tu kolejne robaki.

source_text: Shoo, spider! It’s time to leave!

structure.raw_value: JuWoClNo1.Shoo, spider! It’s time to leave!
structure.script_literal: "JuWoClNo1.Shoo, spider! It’s time to leave!"

translation: A sio, pająku! Pora iść!
